projection.projection_goal: Provide the software-developer skill with a prompt-side execution contract that preserves skill loading terminology, source precedence boundaries, and mandatory clarification rules during implementation tasks.

source_slice.slice_topic: skill loading order, source precedence, and eligibility filtering

concept_mappings.notes: Expose the top-level skills configuration as an approved prompt term so planning and implementation discussions stay aligned with the ontology boundary.
Keep skill definition as an explicit prompt term so generated explanations and plans talk about the same core object the runtime consumes.
Carry source tier into the prompt vocabulary so precedence-sensitive reasoning cannot collapse into informal labels.

relation_mappings.notes: Preserve the dependency between skill definition and source as a permitted reasoning path for implementation guidance and review prompts.

constraint_mappings.notes: Require the prompt layer to preserve higher-priority source precedence and to reject any rewrite that silently inverts overwrite order.

forbidden_assumptions: Do not assume bundled skills always outrank managed or workspace skills.
Do not rename source tiers into informal labels that lose ordering semantics.
required_clarifications: Clarify the active managed skills path if code and documentation appear to drift before proposing implementation changes.

meta.notes: This consumer-skill prompt projection gives software-developer a prompt-side contract for implementation and review tasks while preserving ontology-derived terminology and guardrails.
